assumptions.assumption: The Identity database is confidential because it contains accounts, emails, password hashes, codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
assumptions.basis: The diagram explicitly lists personal account data and credential material in the database.

assumptions.assumption: The Points ledger is confidential because it contains points balances and transactions, including gift card redemptions.
assumptions.basis: The diagram explicitly identifies balances, transactions, and gift card redemptions.

assumptions.assumption: The Mobile app carries credentials because its flows include authorization codes, access tokens, and refresh tokens.
assumptions.basis: The diagram explicitly shows authorization-code flow and access and refresh tokens involving the Mobile app.

assumptions.assumption: The Partner app carries credentials because its flows include authorization codes, token requests, and access tokens.
assumptions.basis: The diagram explicitly shows authorization codes, token requests, and access-token requests involving the Partner app.

assumptions.assumption: The Authorization server handles credentials and personal information because it handles accounts, emails, codes, tokens, and consents.
assumptions.basis: The diagram explicitly lists these records and artifacts in its interactions with the Identity database.

assumptions.assumption: The Rewards API handles credentials and financial data because it accepts access tokens and handles points and gift card redemptions.
assumptions.basis: The diagram explicitly shows access-token requests and points and gift card redemptions.

assumptions.assumption: The Support console handles credentials and personal information because it receives access tokens and closes accounts.
assumptions.basis: The diagram explicitly shows access tokens sent to the console and account closure against the Identity database.

assumptions.assumption: The Identity database stores credentials and personal information because it contains password hashes, codes, refresh tokens, accounts, emails, and consents.
assumptions.basis: The diagram explicitly lists these contents.

assumptions.assumption: The Points ledger stores financial data because it contains points, balances, transactions, and gift card redemptions.
assumptions.basis: The diagram explicitly lists these contents and interactions.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store may hold credentials because it stores every request with headers, including requests shown elsewhere with access tokens.
assumptions.basis: The diagram states that every request is logged with headers and separately shows access tokens in Rewards API requests.
